Carmen G.: tiny repro & weird 'ghost drop' after retry. Node sample app got 1 missing embedding but python had all. Also noticed dims mismatch in some responses (768 vs 1024) on fallback to quantized variant.

Noah V.: paste minimal request + raw http trace?

Carmen G.: node call:
```js
client.embeddings.create({model: 'embed-std-v1', input: ['a','b','c','d','e','f','g'], batch_helper: {enabled: true, max_batch_size: 4}})
```
raw http:
POST /v1/embeddings 200 (4 items)
POST /v1/embeddings 500 -> client retries sub-batch -> 200 (3 items)
final node response has 6 embedding objects; python has 7.

Priya K.: 'ghost drop' name makes sense. Also dims mismatch? where does 768/1024 show up?

Carmen G.: in one trace server returned embeddings of length 768 for one item while rest were 1024. rerank mapper assumes uniform dim and threw away that item. log: "vector_len != expected_len -> drop". So two issues collided: node positional merge + downstream strict-dim check.

Zoe L.: oof. server fallback to smaller model variant can cause dim change. we should never silently return mixed-dim arrays. Server should either convert to canonical dim or include per-item metadata indicating model_id & dim. Also clients must be resilient.

Noah V.: immediate workarounds: 1) set batch_helper.tag_ids=true in node so replays map correctly; 2) disable strict-dim drop in rerank mapper and log mismatch; 3) request header X-Response-Shape: object_items to get per-item model_id and dims.

Priya K.: long term: server will stop mixing dims in a single response. also propose adding meta: {dedupe_count, sub_batch_ids, shape: 'object_items'} and opt-in header as Zoe suggested. add ticket.

sdk-bot: Created DEVEX-5230: "embeddings: prevent mixed-dim responses; add per-item meta + dedupe_count; node auto-tag on retry" https://rwd.in/DEVEX-5230

Zoe L.: migration plan: 1) opt-in X-Response-Shape=object_items for one release, 2) update SDKs to prefer object_items, 3) flip default in two releases, 4) add deprecation note. also add a docs blurb on batch_helper.tag_ids and rerank strict-dim checks.

Carmen G.: i'll try tag_ids=true + object_items on my env. will paste repro and logs into DEVEX-5230. thank you!

Noah V.: also add small CLI fuzz that simulates sub-batch 500 + fallback model variant with different dims so we don't regress.

Priya K.: adding tests & docs tasks to the ticket. thanks team. :thumbsup:
